name: Conductor AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

generalAbilities.name: Painsight
generalAbilities.description: A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the Doomed, Dying, and Wounded conditions, as well as the value of those conditions.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Horrifying Accompaniment
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it hears every scream the velstrac conductor's victims have ever uttered. The creature must succeed at a DC 25 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 on a critical failure).

defensiveAbilities.name: Sonic Redirection
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature targets the velstrac conductor with an auditory or sonic effect or includes the conductor in the area of an auditory or sonic effect

Effect The conductor sings a note that resonates with the triggering effect, redirecting it to the triggering creature. The triggering creature becomes the target of the triggering effect, instead of the conductor.

offensiveAbilities.name: Focus Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description: The velstrac conductor stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The creature must immediately attempt a Will save against the velstrac conductor's horrifying accompaniment aura. In addition, if the creature was already frightened, on a failed save the creature takes 1d6 Persistent,mental Damage damage. After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scream for Me
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect With a horrifying flourish and hungry smile, the velstrac conductor points their baton at a creature within 100 feet, compelling them to scream. The creature must attempt a Basic DC 28 Will Saving Throw save. On a failure, they scream, taking 4d6 Mental Damage damage (8d6 Mental Damage on a critical failure) and dealing 2d6 Sonic Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:emanation (Basic DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

Instead of targeting one creature, the conductor can choose to target all creatures in range that were compelled to scream by this ability last round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unholy Exaltation
offensiveAbilities.description: The conductor lets out a terrible scream of joy, dealing 10d6 Sonic Damage damage to all creatures in either a 30ft Type:cone or a 90ft Type:line (Basic DC 28 Will Saving Throw save). Holy creatures that fail this save are also Sickened 2. The conductor can't use Unholy Exaltation again for 1d4 rounds.

lv2spells.name: Darkness
lv2spells.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as Concealed.

lv3spells.name: Haste
lv3spells.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the Quickened condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

lv4spells.name: Fly (Constant)
lv4spells.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.
